```
if (!env.REMOTE_SHARD_MIGRATE) { return legacyPath(); }
```

sam: will run local smoke that hits the path in a moment.

ci-bot: build passed — 1286 @alex

sam: smoke looks good locally; no regressions on shard lookup.

maria: looks good to me other than one nit about the log level. change to debug please.

alex: updated to debug, rebased and pushed. Also moved the canary window to 2am-3am per infra request. PTAL again when you have a sec.

maria: LGTM :thumbsup: 

alex: thanks! I'll queue for canary and hold off on the prod rollout until monday morning. Also, unrelated — does anyone want to swap lunch on Friday? i'm out but free Tue.
